svg.title: And so, the journey continues
svg.desc: A closing card for Mochaa's Frieren-themed profile: the official art board of a village harbour on the Granz Strait at winter sunrise (painted by Studio Wyeth, ©K.Y.T.A/S/FP), with light snow falling, the music cue The Journey Continues, and the words: And so, the journey continues. Well then, shall we go?
